description: Get Token flow for new users to generate registration tokens

userStories.title: Google Sign-In screen on /get-token
userStories.notes: Sign-in screen with Google button, matching wedding aesthetic. Already have a token? → /register link.

userStories.title: Token request form with Name, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar last 4
userStories.notes: Shows after Google sign-in. Pre-fills name and email from Google profile. Aadhaar is optional. Mobile restricted to 10 digits.

userStories.title: Mobile existence check — returns existing token if found
userStories.notes: Queries tokens collection by mobile. If found, shows existing token with 'Token Found' message.

userStories.title: Unique token generation (KIT-XXXX format) with collision check
userStories.notes: Generates KIT-XXXX with 4 alphanumeric chars (no ambiguous I/O/0/1). Checks for collisions up to 10 attempts.

userStories.title: Save to tokens + users collections, update Firestore rules
userStories.notes: Tokens rule updated to allow authenticated create with used=false and valid mobile. Users collection gets name/mobile/email/aadhaar.

userStories.title: Gate screen Get Token link points to /get-token
